text: Based on Earth-observation data, **0.5 hectares of native forest** were lost on this 17.6-hectare property in 2022. This represents about **3%** of the total property area. The loss was detected using high-resolution satellite imagery (30m pixels) and cross-checked with multiple datasets. The remaining 0.1 hectares of the total 0.6-hectare loss were outside mapped forest areas. The tool does not specify the cause of the loss, only that it involved stand-replacement (e.g., clearing, fire, or harvesting). The property had no planted forests at the time of the loss.
